topic: Continuous spectral-LUT chromatic dispersion vs naive 3-tap RGB channel split ghosting rig
topic_zh: 连续光谱查找表色散积分对比朴素 3 抽头 RGB 通道分离三重鬼影与断层
scope: Deterministic Playdead INSIDE / Guertin (2014) continuous spectral-LUT chromatic dispersion integration versus naive 3-tap RGB channel splitting and 64-tap wavelength quadrature across 17 radial pixel stations (x in [-8, +8] px) for a w = 1.5 px highlight stretched across Δr = 12.0 px. No neural lens simulation execution.

good_fit: Cinematic radial chromatic aberration and barrel lens dispersion in Playdead INSIDE, UE5 PostProcess, and Unity HDRP
Explaining why 3-tap RGB channel splitting breaks thin specular highlights into 3 disconnected Red/Green/Blue ghosts with 6 dead-black gaps
Accumulating jittered multi-tap samples weighted by a normalized spectral LUT ∑ w_λ(t_k) = (1, 1, 1)
Replacing 64-wavelength brute-force quadrature with closed-form spectral overlap integration
not_for: Zero-dispersion pinhole camera renders where all wavelengths focus at identical pixel coordinates
Deliberate retro 1980s VHS / anaglyph 3D-glasses glitch effects where harsh RGB separation is an artistic goal
Neural bokeh or camera-lens style-transfer networks
Text-heavy HUD interfaces that should bypass post-process lens distortion entirely
